name: tracker-launch-queue-recovery
goal: Blocked requests yield to runnable work; unused claims expire safely; withdrawing a launch permits a fresh run

evidence: Primary read-only journal: 14 aged, undispatched native retries belong to flagged items. Current reserved tokens cannot expire even after authoritative absence. A host start exception aborts the whole scheduler tick.

The managed foreground test withdrew before aging the claim; it missed current-token expiry and flagged retry retirement. Scheduler restart fixture did not queue independent work behind an uncertain start.
